subject: Signal and System
questionText:
The region of convergence for the Laplace transform
of a signal x(t) = e–t u(t) + e–t u(–t) is
(a)
 < Re (s) < 
(b)
– < Re (s) < –
(c)
Re (s) > max (,)
(d) Re (s) > max (–, –)
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-18 (EC/EE/IN).
